test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: When 1063, 2815 and 3451 are divided by the greatest number x, the remainder in each case is y. What is the value of (3x − 14y)?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For the same remainder **y**, **x** is the **HCF** of the differences of the numbers.

Differences: |2815 − 1063| = 1752, |3451 − 2815| = 636, |3451 − 1063| = 2388.

**x** = HCF(1752, 636, 2388) = 12.

**y** = Remainder when 1063 ÷ 12 → 1063 = 12 × 88 + 7 ∴ **y = 7**.

Value = 3(12) − 14(7) = 36 − 98 = −62.

**∴ The correct answer is −62.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Numbers are 1063, 2815, and 3451. Greatest divisor is **x** and constant remainder is **y**.

**Formula Used:** x = HCF(|a−b|, |b−c|, |c−a|)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5a9c157bec11f82d759ef95eee20bfd222a5e6caad9250bed36290ea5f2ea22.png] 

⇒ Step 1: Find differences between the numbers:

⇒ 2815 − 1063 = 1752

⇒ 3451 − 2815 = 636

⇒ Step 2: Find HCF of 1752 and 636:

⇒ 1752 = 636 × 2 + 480

⇒ 636 = 480 × 1 + 156

⇒ 480 = 156 × 3 + 12

⇒ 156 = 12 × 13 + 0

⇒ ∴ **x = 12**

⇒ Step 3: Find remainder **y**:

⇒ 1063 ÷ 12 ⇒ Quotient = 88, Remainder = 1063 − (12 × 88) = 1063 − 1056 = 7

⇒ ∴ **y = 7**

⇒ Step 4: Calculate 3x − 14y:

⇒ 3(12) − 14(7) = 36 − 98 = −62

**∴ The correct answer is −62.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

HCF with Constant Remainder

When numbers a, b, and c are divided by **x** to leave the same remainder, **x** is always a factor of (a−b), (b−c), and (c−a).

Euclidean Algorithm

A fast method to find HCF by repeated division: HCF(a, b) = HCF(b, a mod b) until the remainder becomes zero.

Finding the Remainder

Once the divisor **x** is found, the remainder **y** is calculated using the property: Number = (x × Quotient) + y.</p
